artists.biography:
Run the Jewels is an American hip hop duo, formed by rappers El-P and Killer Mike in 2013. That same year, they released their self-titled first album titled Run the Jewels, as a free digital download.

In 2012, El-P produced Killer Mike’s critically acclaimed album R.A.P. Music. Later that year, Killer Mike appeared on the track “Tougher Colder Killer” from El-P’s Cancer 4 Cure. The following year they officially formed the duo “Run the Jewels”, with an album under Fool’s Gold Records announced for later in the year. They released their self-titled first album titled Run the Jewels, as a free digital download.

On August 21, 2014 EL-P & Killer Mike officially announced their follow up record, Run the Jewels 2. It was released through Mass Appeal Records, on October 24, 2014. They also announced the release of a traditional remix album of Run the Jewels 2, which will be released via Fool's Gold Records in 2015, and a light-hearted remix featuring entirely "cat sounds" as of now to be titled "Meow the Jewels" which will feature guest production from the likes of Prince Paul, Alchemist, Just Blaze and others. Proceeds from the latter will go entirely to charity.

perplexity.description:
Run the Jewels 2 is the second studio album by the hip hop duo Run the Jewels, consisting of Killer Mike and El-P. Released on October 24, 2014, through Mass Appeal Records, the album arrived just one year after the duo's acclaimed self-titled debut. The project marked a deliberate artistic evolution for the pair, who sought to deepen their thematic scope beyond the braggadocio and defiant attitude that characterized their first record, instead engaging with more complex social and political issues.

Musically, Run the Jewels 2 showcases darker and more layered production compared to its predecessor, with El-P's intricate beats complementing the sharp lyricism and chemistry between Killer Mike and El-P. The album spans 11 tracks across approximately 39 minutes and features notable guest contributions that enhance its sonic palette. The production demonstrates increased sophistication in both arrangement and thematic depth, with the duo tackling substantive subject matter while maintaining the aggressive energy characteristic of hardcore hip hop.

The album received widespread critical acclaim upon its release, with several major publications including Pitchfork and Complex naming it the best album of 2014. Critics particularly praised the duo's lyrical prowess, their complementary chemistry, and the album's ambitious production work. Run the Jewels 2 solidified the duo's status as a significant force in contemporary hip hop and established the foundation for their continued success in subsequent years.
